title: Operations Support Specialist (Work from Home)
description:
Operations Support Specialist (Work from Home)

The Operations Support Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring a seamless learning experience by providing comprehensive support to our contracted tutors and students. This fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment requires a self‑starter and problem‑solver with a passion for helping people learn. The position is ideal for individuals who are adaptable and thrive in a dynamic contact center setting.

About Nerdy

At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we're redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live & AI™ platform fuses real‑time human expertise with proprietary generative‑AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale.
We recruit the kind of technologists and operators you'd bet on as solo founders – people who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10‑times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win.

How we compete

  • AI‑Native at every level – From the CEO to day‑one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you're not wielding AI, you're not done.
  • Entrepreneurial velocity – Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die.
  • Free‑market rigor – Ideas rise or fall on merit and results – no committees, no politics, no cap on upside.
  • Full‑stack ownership – You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug.
  • Reward for contribution – Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both what you achieve and how you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded.
  • Relentless exploration – Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and – because only the paranoid survive – questioning every legacy assumption along the way.
  • Is Apolitical – You stay focused on mission‑aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Comprehensive Tutor Support
    • Handle inbound inquiries via phone, chat, email, and video within our learning platform.
    • Assist tutors with account setup, specific student opportunities/assignments, tutoring product inquiries, scheduling conflicts, and payment/payroll questions.
    • Complete various tutor support tasks, including account updates, reviews, document reviews, and subject assessments.
  • Resolve Technical Issues
    • Provide real‑time technical assistance to both instructors and students via chat and video.
    • Follow up on technical issues submitted via email, phone, chat, or video.
    • Escalate unresolved technical issues to the engineering team as per established processes.
  • Support and Audit Tutoring Sessions
    • Monitor live online classes to ensure quality and adherence to guidelines.
    • Assist instructors with starting and ending class sessions.
  • Provide Insights for School System Partners
    • Address and resolve complaints, offering appropriate solutions and alternatives.
    • Evaluate quality inputs such as compliance with client‑defined requirements, tutor preparedness, and platform ease of use.
    • Intervene to address defects, including replacing tutors when necessary and escalating issues that impede student learning.

Qualifications

  • B2 English proficiency.
  • Prior experience in a customer service contact center, handling inbound calls, chats, emails, or workloads.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • A solutions‑based mindset, consistently seeking effective resolutions for end users.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to work independently as a self‑starter.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a dynamic environment with quickly changing priorities.
  • Willingness and ability to quickly learn business practices, policies, and procedures.
  • A commitment to going above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to demonstrate empathy and understanding when interacting with end users.
  • Comfortable performing all job responsibilities on a laptop or computer.
  • Able to perform basic technical troubleshooting with work equipment.
  • Reliable high‑speed internet access (100 Mbps download, 25 Mbps upload) via wired ethernet connection (no Wi‑Fi, Satellite, or Cellular Hotspot/Internet).
  • A quiet work environment that promotes focus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience in recruiting, education, customer service, retail, or another fast‑paced environment.
  • An Associate's degree or higher.
  • Experience with technical support.
  • Experience with Zendesk.

Work Schedule

  • Ability to work full‑time (40 hours per week).
  • Evenings and weekends are required based on available shifts.
  • Shifts may be adjusted seasonally based on demand.
  • Operating day is from 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM CDT.

Unleash Your Full Potential at Nerdy

  • Competitive Opportunity – Market‑leading compensation ($12 /hr USD), with performance‑driven growth opportunities, where results drive rewards.
  • 100% Remote – Work from anywhere in your home country.
  • Flexible Time Away – Coordinate with your team for planned time off, keeping our global platform running seamlessly.
  • Continuous Learning – A fully paid Learning Membership for you and immediate family members—including 1:1 tutoring, unlimited on‑demand classes, and full suite access. A unique benefit that supports personal development and helps you experience the same product you'll be supporting.
  • Training & Feedback – A fast‑paced, collaborative, and team‑oriented work environment with plenty of training and a feedback‑rich culture.
  • Supercharge with AI – Leverage cutting‑edge AI tools to enhance your results and daily wins!
  • Global Impact – Contribute to an innovative platform used by learners around the world.
  • Learn With Us – Access to our learning membership and 4 tutoring hours to use per month!

description:
CIEE Rio Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Quem Somos?

A indústria brasileira cria mais do que produtos, ela cria oportunidades e transforma vidas! No SENAI CETIQT nós trabalhamos para transformar vidas desenvolvendo oportunidades e soluções para uma indústria têxtil, química e de confecção mais inovadora, tecnológica e sustentável. Antes de te apresentar quem somos é muito importante que você conheça o significado do nosso nome: SENAI significa Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial e CETIQT é um Centro de Tecnologia da Indústria Química e Têxtil . Só pelo significado dos nomes você já consegue entender a relevância e papel estratégico que a nossa instituição desempenha ao apoiar o sistema S (SENAI, SESI, IEL) e capacitar profissionais para as demandas da indústria brasileira. Porém, nós vamos muito além da capacitação de profissionais por meio de graduações, pós-graduações e cursos de curta duração. Nós também desenvolvemos tecnologias, oferecemos consultorias em diversas áreas para empresas, microempreendedores e para a Defesa Estratégica do país, como as forças armadas, realizamos testes metrológicos acreditados pelo INMETRO, promovemos estudos de futuro, e personalizamos o ensino técnico para a necessidade das indústrias têxteis, de confecção e química.

O SENAI CETIQT é um centro de excelência reconhecido nacionalmente pela sua capacidade de gerar conhecimento e inovação para as cadeias produtivas dos setores químico, têxtil e de confecção. Com mais de 75 anos de história, a instituição desempenha um papel fundamental no fortalecimento do futuro da indústria química e da moda, formando profissionais altamente capacitados, oferecendo consultorias especializadas e customizadas, e impulsionando o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, processos e projetos de pesquisa. Alinhado às necessidades da indústria brasileira e às principais tendências globais, o SENAI CETIQT se dedica a promover a inovação, a sustentabilidade e a competitividade da indústria nacional, consolidando-se como um pilar essencial para o crescimento e a transformação do setor.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Apoiar no desenvolvimento de recursos educacionais e ferramentas EAD.
  2. Apoiar na elaboração dos materiais didáticos online, ebooks, e interfaces digitais, com foco na experiência do usuário.
  3. Apoiar na elaboração dos materiais gráficos, infografias, edições de imagens, apresentações, ilustrações, storyboard e identidade visual.
  4. Apoiar em atividades de desenvolvimento de front-end.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • É necessário ter concluído 50% da graduação em Design Gráfico, Web Design, Design Digital, Desenho Industrial ou Comunicação Visual e estar entre o 5º período ao 6º período.

title: [2025] Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro
description:
(2025) Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA PRICING NA YDUQS.

Main responsibilities

Os principais desafios como PESSOA ANALISTA PRICING PLENO são:

  • Forecast e orçamento: Apoiar na elaboração de previsões de receita, revisões semanais de planejamento e análises de impactos de reajustes e orçamentos;
  • Atuação integrada: Interagir com diferentes áreas e níveis executivos, apresentando análises e insights estratégicos de forma clara e convincente.

  • A quiet work environment that promotes focus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience in recruiting, education, customer service, retail, or another fast‑paced environment.
  • An Associate's degree or higher.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Slack and AI Support Tools.

Work Schedule

  • Ability to work full‑time (40 hours per week).
  • Evenings, weekends, and holidays are required based on available shifts.
  • Operating day is from 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM CDT.

Unleash Your Full Potential at Nerdy

  • Competitive Opportunity: Market‑leading compensation ($12/hr USD), with performance‑driven growth opportunities and rewards based on results.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in your home country.

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Coordinator who values openness, collaboration, and trust, and who wants to make a real impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues.

Who are we?

At MSS, we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team that cares about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll join a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration and respect. We offer:

  • A flexible, energised work environment where ideas are valued.
  • A culture that celebrates diversity and teamwork—“we” comes before “I”.
  • The opportunity to shape the future of our operations and support the growth of new seafarers through our Cadet Programme.

This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection. As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What you’ll do

Your mission is simple yet powerful: attract and engage the best maritime talent while ensuring our offshore colleagues feel valued and supported .

You’ll lead initiatives that go beyond filling positions—creating meaningful connections and building trust with candidates and stakeholders. From crafting employer branding to managing end-to-end recruitment, you’ll ensure every interaction reflects our values.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Drive talent attraction strategies aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of skilled professionals for offshore roles.
  • Lead the Cadet Programme, supporting the next generation of seafarers.
  • Act as a trusted partner to hiring managers, providing insights and guidance.
  • Champion diversity and inclusion in all recruitment activities and find the candidate with the cultural fit to the company.
  • Continuously improve processes to enhance candidate experience and efficiency.
  • Coordinate offshore recruitment, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, Petrobras).
  • Plan and conduct recruitment for key maritime positions: Captain, Chief Officer, Deck Officer, Chief Engineer, 2nd Engineer Officer, Electrician/ETO, Able Seafarers and Motormen, Cooks and Stewards, etc.
  • Monitor KPIs, report results, and propose improvements.
  • Ensure that candidate records, certifications, and technical documentation are updated and accurate.
  • Support audits and collaborate with Payroll, Training & Compliance, and Vessel Operations.
  • Manage onboarding/offboarding and participate in the Crewing Duty Phone rotation.

Operational excellence will underpin your work—maintaining accurate candidate data, ensuring compliance with maritime regulations, and collaborating across HR, Payroll, Training, and Vessel Operations teams. You’ll also contribute to shaping the future of our talent strategy through innovative ideas and quality-driven initiatives.

Who you are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry and enjoy building trusted relationships, and you recognize the game‑changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, HR, or related field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in offshore recruitment.
  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Knowledge of maritime regulations (MLC, STCW, NR-30, NORMAM).
  • Proven previous experience conducting recruitment processes for maritime positions.
  • Skilled in recruitment platforms and advanced Excel.
  • Strategic mindset, strong networking skills, and ability to work independently.
  • Passion for the maritime industry and commitment to diversity and inclusion.
  • Strong decision‑making, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in lean organisations and proactive process improvement.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast‑paced environments.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 30 November 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

  • Modelagem DCF para investimentos em studios e conversões
  • ROI de reformas e CapEx por tipologia de imóvel
  • Análise de custos operacionais e otimização de margem

Suporte Estratégico

Quem Buscamos

  • Formação : Economia (essencial) - cursando a partir do 4º período ou recém-formado

O que você precisa ter :

  • Raciocínio quantitativo forte - você vê padrões em dados, não só números
  • Excel avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, funções complexas, modelagem financeira
  • Comunicação clara - transforma análise em insight acionável (oral e escrito )
  • Autonomia executiva - não espera task list, vai atrás do problema
  • Resiliência analítica - lida com dados bagunçados, premissas incertas, pivots rápidos

Diferenciais que amamos :

  • Python / R para análise de dados
  • Power BI, Looker ou ferramentas de visualização
  • Conhecimento de real estate, hospitalidade ou marketplace

  • Executa rápido, itera mais rápido - prefere testar 80% correto hoje do que 100% perfeito nunca
  • Faz perguntas difíceis - questiona premissas, aponta riscos, propõe alternativas

title: Sr. HSE Operations Engineer
description:
Employer company TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Context & Environment

O Brasil é um país altamente regulado, com exigências rigorosas de SSMS e necessidade de demonstração de gestão de riscos às autoridades como pré-requisito obrigatório para qualquer operação. A TotalEnergies EP Brasil é uma afilial estratégica para o Grupo, em fase de crescimento (200 mil bpd em participação do Grupo até 2025). A excelência na gestão de riscos operacionais contribui para a expansão do portfólio operado e para o aumento da influência sobre os parceiros responsáveis por ativos estratégicos operados por terceiros (OBOs). A excelência em SSMS, Segurança e Integridade garante a sustentabilidade da reputação da TotalEnergies no Brasil, ao mesmo tempo em que preserva a vida de todos os envolvidos.

Realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios do OneMAESTRO, visando preservar o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e descarbonização dos ativos da empresa.

  • Participar de estudos de perigos e avaliações de riscos para garantir a execução segura dos programas operacionais.

  • Promover e incentivar o conceito de “Visita de Campo Gerencia em Conjunto” (Management Joint Safety Tour/Boots on the Ground).

  • Dar assistência, aconselhar e aprimorar as análises de causa raiz de incidentes e incidentes com Alto Potencial.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração das “Análises de Segurança das Atividades” dos contratados relacionadas à execução das atividades.

    • preparação de operações de içamento.
    • prevenção de queda de objetos.
    • prevenção de lesões nas mãos.
    • operações simultâneas.
    • operações críticas.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar para garantir os prazos e acuidade dos relatórios de eventos, incidentes, acidentes e anomalias.
  • Garantir o monitoramento da performance de HSE e benchmarking relacionados os KPIs atualizados, conhecidos e acompanhados.
  • Auxiliar e aconselhar no aprimoramento da competência e treinamento das equipes em HSE (empresa e contratados).
  • Garantir os prazos e acuidade ao reportar os eventos de HSE no sistema OneSynergi.
  • Fornecer treinamentos específicos de HSE no campo, conforme necessário, garantindo a inclusão de toda a supervisão dos contratados.

title: Senior Budget Officer
description:
Senior Budget Officer

Position within the Talent Acquisition department at Howard University. The Senior Budget Officer is responsible for a portion of the university’s operating budget, collaborating with schools, departments, and leadership to develop, monitor, analyze, and forecast budget data.

Responsibilities

  • Consult with units or departments to coordinate the preparation of operating budgets based on actual performance, previous budget figures, estimated revenue, expense reports, and other factors.
  • Compare university and departmental expenditures with budget allocations, analyze budgets, and recommend approvals to management.
  • Consult with units or departments regarding budget analysis, financial reports, reconciliation, irregular and unusual transactions, and problem resolutions.
  • Confer with department heads and directors regarding budgetary controls.
  • Monitor revenue and expense accounts to identify problem accounts.
  • Research, compile, and update budgetary and forecast data for various financial reports.
  • Consult with key stakeholders to facilitate personnel and non‑personnel budget adjustments in Workday.
  • Effectively manage a Workday worklist in a timely manner.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of the university’s budget model, budget reporting, and associated processes through a consensus‑oriented process.
  • Provide functional leadership for Workday control and associated budget‑related issues in other modules within the university’s Workday financial system, ensuring that central and campus user requirements are reflected in system design, configuration, reporting, and upgrades.
  • Assist with the development of content and workbooks for the university’s annual budget training process.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Leadership & Supervisory Accountability

  • Orient and train Budget Officers and review their work.
  • Act in a lead capacity over other positions performing similar or related tasks, reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of analytical budgetary accounting.
  • Knowledge of the budgeting cycle and process.
  • Ability to prepare comprehensive, complex financial and budget reports.
  • Ability to formulate comprehensive budget planning processes.
  • Strong oral and written communication in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective work relations with faculty, staff, students, and customers.
  • Familiarity with various budget models.
  • High proficiency in statistical analysis, revenue forecasting, financial modeling, project modeling and business plan development.
  • High proficiency in MS Excel.
  • Strong planning, analysis, and management skills.
  • Experience leading complex financial systems and organizations.
  • Experience operating as a team member; willingness to participate in team interactions, thinking, and decision‑making.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Coalition building and collaboration skills; commitment to diversity, inclusion, and collaborative decision‑making in the workplace.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of seven (7) years of training and experience.
  • Experience demonstrating good knowledge and skill in grant administration, higher education finance, and expertise in computerized financial accounting systems preferred.

Compensation

Compensation Range: $88,200 – $98,000.

title: Technical Account Manager - Commerce / Partner Success (100% Remote - Brazil)
description:
***Employment Modality (Brazil - EOR): This remote role will be classified as a long-term Employment Relationship (Relação de Emprego) under the Brazilian Consolidated Labor Laws (CLT) . The contract will be managed through a local Employer of Record (EOR) to ensure full compliance with all Brazilian labor laws, including benefits, mandatory contributions, and tenure.

About the job

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) powers the white‑label travel platforms for some of the world’s largest financial institutions and airlines. As our strategic partner portfolio expands, so too does the need for sophisticated technical expertise and dedicated relationship management.

We are seeking a high‑impact Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be a technical liaison for multiple strategic partners. This critical role acts as the connective architect, seamlessly integrating Product, Engineering, Supply, and Customer Experience teams to ensure every partner receives clear, consistent, and exceptionally reliable support for technical inquiries and strategic growth initiatives.

This is a hands‑on, results‑oriented position. You will use your diagnostic skills and analytical abilities to validate incoming issues, structure comprehensive problem reports, and coordinate effectively with engineering. Your main goal is to ensure that all technical escalations are complete, actionable, and correctly prioritized. You will also play a key part in defining and optimizing our global intake, triage, communication, and escalation frameworks, helping partners get timely resolutions while keeping internal teams focused and efficient.

In short, this role requires a blend of investigative curiosity, clear communication, strong organizational skills, and a process‑improvement mindset, applied across a dynamic portfolio of partners and parallel technical workstreams.

What would your day‑to‑day look like

Partner Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for multiple B2B partners, each with unique needs, priorities, and communication channels.
  • Translate partner inquiries into structured, actionable requests with complete context.
  • Provide clear updates, timelines, and expectations, ensuring partners feel supported and aligned.

Technical Triage & Analysis

  • Assess and validate reported issues before escalating to engineering, including reproduction steps, logs, context, severity assessment, and relevant data insights.
  • Investigate technical or data‑centric questions using internal tools, dashboards, and SQL; identify whether issues stem from configuration, supply content, product behavior, data quality, or true system defects.
  • Manage and prioritize requests across multiple partners simultaneously, balancing urgency, impact, and engineering bandwidth.

Process & Program Development

  • Improve intake workflows, templates, and triage mechanisms to create consistency across partners.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, supply, and Customer Experience teams to refine escalation paths, service expectations, and communication standards.
  • Contribute to playbooks, documentation, and partner‑facing resources to strengthen transparency and scale operational excellence.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with a wide and diverse set of stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, supply specialists, Customer Experience teams, and external partner teams.
  • Maintain clear follow‑through, alignment, and ownership across parallel workstreams.
  • Advocate for partner needs while helping internal teams maintain focus and momentum.

An ideal candidate has

  • An excellent communicator who can build trust with partners and internal teams through clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Comfortable operating across several partners at once, with strong prioritization, context‑switching, and organizational skills.
  • Adept at turning ambiguity into clarity and designing repeatable processes that scale.
  • Technically fluent, with experience interpreting logs, analyzing data, exploring APIs, and using monitoring tools to support issue investigation and triage.
  • Experienced in roles such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Product Specialist, or a similar hybrid technical‑customer role.
  • Strong judgment in evaluating issue severity, partner impact, and operational urgency.

Nice to Haves

  • Intermediate or advanced SQL skills; experience working with data analysis, BI tools, or large datasets (BigQuery experience is a plus).
  • Familiarity with API debugging, distributed systems, or SaaS platform operations.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing ticketing and triage systems (Zendesk, Jira Service Desk, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Background improving cross‑functional workflows or partner‑facing operations at scale.

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life short‑term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

  • Contribuir para projetos de melhoria da infraestrutura, incluindo testes e validações;
  • Auxiliar na aplicação de políticas de segurança de rede, como ACLs e boas práticas;

Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Monitor performance, lubricate, and maintain the engines and other mechanical equipment onboard the vessel.

Descrição do Cargo

Reporting: Reports to Chief Mechanic/Mechanic or Second Engineer/Third Engineer.

Supervision: None.

Pre-requisite / Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.)/Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Basic Computer Skills

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well‑being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit.
  • Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Complete company training requirements for the Oiler job level as per the training matrix, including local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • Understanding and performing the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting.
  • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
  • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognize at risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
  • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Protect personnel, the environment, and assets by eliminating hazards and reducing health and safety risks.
  • Understand Company OI & HSE requirements applicable to the job position.
  • Execute work in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations to a supervisor.
  • Incorporate the Control of Work process into all work, whether working alone or as part of a team.
  • Understand and implement major accident barriers / controls applicable to the job position.
  • Maintain a safe and organized work area throughout and on completion of all work.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.

Duties

The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Oiler, the Supervisor and the Oiler will apply the Control of Work process to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed.

Operations / Maintenance – General Duties

  • Lubricate moving parts such as gears, shafts, and bearings on engines and auxiliary equipment.
  • Monitor working temperatures and pressures on all engine room and associated equipment.
  • Check and record lubricating oil level readings—top up as required.
  • Maintain daily log of all engine room equipment.
  • Monitor all engine room systems for leaks and report any defects immediately.
  • Carry out routine maintenance and minor repairs on the engine room equipment and machinery as directed.
  • Assist with repairs to engines and equipment in engine room and machine shop.
  • Maintain the engine room and associated workshop in a clean, tidy and hazard‑free condition.

Desde então, temos atuado em diversos segmentos da economia brasileira, como óleo e gás, químico e petroquímico, farmacêutico e siderúrgico. Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau.

Com foco em inovação, a SANDECH adota tecnologias avançadas, como drones, laser scan, integração ao modelo BIM e óculos de realidade virtual, sempre buscando otimizar processos e elevar o nível de precisão e eficiência de seus projetos. Esse compromisso com a excelência também se reflete no Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, certificado internacionalmente pela ABS Quality Evaluations na norma ISO 9001:2015 e aprovado em auditorias realizadas por cinco de seus principais clientes. Com um SGQ maduro e bem estruturado, estamos habilitados a executar projetos de engenharia considerados críticos.

Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira.

  • Atualizar planilhas, bancos de dados e sistemas internos de controle comercial;

description:

SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA: Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global. Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial. ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA: Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas. Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias. Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento). Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho. Matemática e Validação de Jogos Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade. Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados. Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados. Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia). Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade. Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais. Suporte Interfuncional Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade. Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis. Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos. RESULTADOS ESPERADOS: Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto). Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática. Documento com Diretrizes de Localização. Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação. Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos. REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS: Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos. Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios. Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação. Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade. Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global) O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI: Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. title: Secretária
description:
SECRETÁ RIA CRC | CLÍ NICA ODONTOLÓ GICA SORRISOS
⚠️ REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓ RIOS: EXPERIÊ NCIA EM CLÍ NICA MÉ DICA OU ODONTOLÓ GICA + RESIDIR NOS BAIRROS ESPECÍ FICOS MENCIONADOS ABAIXO ⚠️
QUEM SOMOS:
Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.
NOSSA VISÃ O
Ser uma clínica referência em odontologia de excelência, proporcionando qualidade de vida e saúde bucal através de uma experiência única para nossos clientes. Aqui, cada paciente que chega com traumas e frustrações de experiências anteriores encontra acolhimento, profissionalismo e resultados transformadores.
A OPORTUNIDADE
Buscamos uma Secretária para nossa Central de Relacionamento com o Cliente (CRC) que compartilhe nossa paixão por transformar vidas e seja o primeiro sorriso acolhedor que nossos pacientes encontram ao chegar à clínica.
REQUISITOS ELIMINATÓ RIOS:
• Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediato
RESPONSABILIDADES:
• Primeiro Contato: Ser a voz e o rosto acolhedor da nossa clínica, recebendo pacientes com empatia e alegria • Gestão de Agenda: Organizar e otimizar os horários dos profissionais, confirmando consultas e evitando faltas • Comunicação Efetiva: Orientar pacientes sobre tratamentos e procedimentos com clareza e segurança • Organização Impecável: Manter prontuários, documentos e sistema atualizados para garantir processos eficientes • Suporte Administrativo: Auxiliar na parte administrativa da clínica, contribuindo para o fluxo de trabalho otimizado
O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:
• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade
POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓ S?
• Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes
INFORMAÇÕ ES ADICIONAIS
• Regime de Contratação: CLT • Local de Trabalho: CAMPO GRANDE. RJ • Horário: Segunda a sexta, horário comercial (disponibilidade para alguns sábados)
. Remuneração: R$ 2.000,00 + comissão e benefícios
COMO SE CANDIDATAR
Envie seu currículo para COM. BR com o assunto " Secretária CRC - SORRISOS", destacando seu bairro de residência logo no início do e-mail.
IMPORTANTE: Currículos sem a informação do bairro de residência ou de candidatas residentes fora das áreas mencionadas não serão avaliados.
Se você acredita no poder de um sorriso para transformar vidas e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que trabalha com propósito, queremos conhecer você!

title: Advogada especialista em governança e compliance
description:
PRÉ-REQUISITOS:  
Bacharel em Direito.
Pós-graduação ou Cursos em Governança e/ou Compliance.
Experiência prática comprovada sobre o tema de GRC (Governança Riscos e Compliance).
Inglês avançado.
100% Presencial | Disponibilidade para trabalho no Centro do RJ.  
DIFERENCIAIS  
Experiência prática comprovada na área de instituições de pagamento ou financeiras.
Experiência em auditoria e controles internos.
Capacidade analítica de dados, com experiência em construção de fluxos e processos.
Forte interesse em temas de inovação tecnológica e meios de pagamento.
Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
Habilidade para liderar projetos de alto impacto e trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares.
Horário flexível.
Organização, disciplina, liderança e trabalho em equipe.  
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES  
 
Analisar documentos, qualificações, estruturas societárias e padrões de governança corporativa.
Construir políticas, normativas, documentos e fluxos operacionais.
Usar automação de processos e relatórios pra construção de fluxos e procedimentos operacionais.
Implementar controles regulatórios e alinhados com frameworks reconhecidos no mercado.
Desenvolver conteúdo para programas e iniciativas abrangentes de conscientização.
Suportar processos de Auditoria Interna com foco regulatório.
Implementar e monitorar planos de ação e planos de auditoria.
Desenvolver e manter atualizados os programas de Compliance.
Implementar políticas de Compliance, tais como: Anticorrupção, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Combate ao Terrorismo, Ética e Conduta, Due Diligence com terceiros, entre outras.
Gerir riscos, identificando proativamente riscos legais e regulatórios e desenvolvendo estratégias de mitigação de impacto.
Mapear processos/procedimentos para Controles Internos de PLD (Prevenção a Lavagem de Dinheiro).
Monitorar cenário regulatório.  
FONTES & TARSO RIBEIRO ADVOGADOS
Fundado pelo ex-Ministro da Justiça Paulo de Tarso Ribeiro e pelos advogados Max Fontes e Marcus Fontes, mestres em Direito pela HARVARD LAW SCHOOL, o escritório FTR ADVOGADOS é fruto da união de profissionais comprometidos com a excelência na prestação de serviços advocatícios há mais de 20 anos.
No FTR, utilizamos o Direito como uma ferramenta para negócios e mitigação de riscos.
 
Com escritórios no RJ e SP, atuação full service e multidisciplinar (desde o consultivo ao contencioso), o FTR tem como um dos seus principais pilares a inovação constante e caracteriza-se por uma dinâmica de trabalho extremamente ágil, estrutura horizontal e acesso direto aos sócios, permitindo um crescimento profissional rápido, multidisciplinar e integrado.
Há anos, o FTR impulsiona e relaciona-se com diversas startups e empresas de inovação, para utilizar a inteligência dos dados em otimização de eficiência e mitigação de riscos de clientes.  
Atualmente, FTR desenvolve projetos com IA, plataformas de analytics e programas de GRC para gestão, compliance, mitigação de riscos | fraudes. Vivemos a rotina de projetos e nossa equipe é multidisciplinar e ágil. Trazemos soluções aos clientes. Oferecemos inovação ao mercado. Somos inquietos por natureza. E sempre mantemos nosso lema de: essência, experiência e excelência.

title: Hardware test & verification designer
description:
At TOPIC ( in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer
with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?
“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”
Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems
What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.
Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:
Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.
What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions
This will make you better:
Permanent contract
An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support
This will keep you healthy:
Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
Regular fun, social, and sports events
What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
Proficient in Python (required); experience with Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ is a plus;
Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.
Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.
Diversity & Inclusion
At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Development (fundraiser) officer

The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning. The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.

Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.

Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
Between 1 and 3 years of experience.

Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.

Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Jira;

Confluence;

Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.

planilhas, visando disponibilizar informações gerenciais para a análise e tomada de decisão. Negociar com os novos credenciamentos a aplicação e padronização e referente as tabelas utilizadas pela companhia;

Manter-se atualizado com as informações referentes ao negócio, bem como sobre projetos de expansão, legislação, concorrentes, clientes (operadora, médicos, clinicas, operadoras, etc.) e novas oportunidades;
Elaborar simulações de impacto financeiro com base nas solicitações de reajuste das Unimeds para renovação contratual;
Assessorar a Diretoria, a Superintendência, a Gerência nas demandas de relacionamento com
as Unimeds (custos, indicadores, reuniões). Parametrizar sistema interno com as regras contratuais e tabelas de pagamentos negociadas;
Manter constante contato com a área comercial, visando conhecer os novos negócios e ampliação dos atuais contratos, atuando proativamente na ampliação da rede de
credenciamento;
Pesquisar a abertura de novas unidades aos clientes, e/ou novos contratos em andamento e providenciar a rede credenciada necessária para atendimento, bem como manter a interface com a área de credenciamento para auxiliar no processo do credenciamento, e envio da documentação para credenciamento dos prestadores;

Ensino Superior Completo;
Pacote office intermédiário;
Experiência com credenciamento de rede ambulatorial;

Vaga extensiva a Pessoas com Deficiência - PCD;

title: Gerente comercial (design / mobiliário / arquitetura)
description:

A Boobam conecta arquitetos, clientes e os principais designers e artistas do Brasil em um só lugar.
Somos a maior plataforma de design assinado do país, reunindo mais de 1.500 designers e 16.000 peças entre mobiliário e arte. Unimos tecnologia e curadoria para reduzir fricções e tornar o design brasileiro “menos inacessível”.
Depois de consolidar nossa primeira loja em Pinheiros (SP), estamos expandindo nossa presença física com a nova loja Boobam Ipanema, no Rio de Janeiro

Sobre a vaga 
Estamos em busca de um Gerente Comercial com sólida experiência em gestão comercial no setor de design, mobiliário ou arquitetura para liderar a operação da nossa nova loja em Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro.
O papel combina gestão comercial, liderança de equipe e relacionamento com arquitetos. Buscamos uma pessoa proativa, prática, hands on com energia para arregaçar as mangas quando necessário.
Se você é ambicioso, apaixonado por design brasileiro, e tem aquele olhar afiado para gestão, resultados e experiência do cliente, essa vaga é pra você!

Responsabilidades
Recrutar, treinar e liderar o time de consultores de vendas do Rio de Janeiro.
Gerenciar a rotina operacional e administrativa da loja (abertura, fechamento, estoque, escala e processos do dia a dia.
Conduzir 1:1s semanais com o time, acompanhando resultados, experiência de atendimento e indicadores de recorrência.
Capacitar o time para construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos e duradouros com arquitetos e especificadores locais.
Acompanhar de perto o pipeline de vendas da loja (via CRM), oferecendo suporte direto aos consultores em negociações, follow-ups e fechamentos.
Garantir um atendimento impecável a arquitetos e clientes finais
Gerenciar as carteiras de arquitetos e promover ações de relacionamento locais, estimulando o engajamento e a recorrência de arquitetos na base.
Organizar eventos e ativações na loja em parceria com o marketing.
Apoiar a curadoria do espaço físico junto com time de VM
Reportar resultados e insights semanalmente à Diretoria Comercial.
Requisitos
Experiência mínima de 2 anos em vendas e liderança comercial, no setor de design, mobiliário ou arquitetura — requisito essencial.
Conhecimento sólido em venda consultiva e relacionamento com arquitetos.
Paixão por design e arquitetura.
Perfil analítico e familiaridade com CRM (Pipedrive é um diferencial).
Organizado, detalhista e com boa capacidade de delegar responsabilidades.
Formação em Arquitetura ou Design de Interiores ( desejável ) Experiência com vendas no mercado de luxo ou tickets altos (um plus)
inglês desejável

Oportunidade real de crescimento profissional em uma empresa inovadora e em expansão
Salário fixo + comissão sobre resultados das vendas do time
Programa de desconto nos produtos Boobam

description:

Gestão de fornecedores : gerenciar contratos e performance de prestadores de serviços, verificando conformidade técnica, SLAs e indicadores de qualidade. Inovação e transformação digital: fomentar uso de novas tecnologias (cloud, analytics, automação) para ganhos de eficiência e competitividade. Gestão de equipe e clima organizacional: liderar e desenvolver o time, definindo prioridades, promovendo ambiente saudável, incentivando capacitação contínua e cultura de feedback. Sustentabilidade e TI: assegurar práticas sustentáveis no ciclo de vida dos ativos de TI e integração às políticas de sustentabilidade da empresa.
Gestão de riscos e continuidade: identificar, monitorar e mitigar riscos operacionais e tecnológicos, garantindo planos de contingência e continuidade de negócio.

Sólido conhecimento técnico em S/4 (e módulos integrados) e pelo menos uma das seguintes áreas: Desenvolvimento de sistemas e integração de aplicações e/ou Gestão de projetos (PMI, PRINCE2, metodologias ágeis);
Sólida experiência como líder de projetos ou equipes de TI;
Experiência prévia em gestão de fornecedores, contratos e SLAs;
Vivência na operação de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, com alta disponibilidade e contingência.
Experiência com gestão de equipes terceirizadas, descentralizadas e multidisciplinares.
Experiência com gestão orçamentária (CAPEX e OPEX) com foco em eficiência e governança.
Desejável conhecimento do setor de Energia Elétrica, especialmente Transmissão, bem como normas e regulamentações da ANEEL.

Superior completo em Análise de Sistemas, Engenharias, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
Desejável Pós Graduação em Tecnologia, Administração ou Gestão de Projetos

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Canada.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Operations manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.
Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.
Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.
Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.
Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.
Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.
Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.
Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.
Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.
Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.
Personal Attributes
Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.
Additional Information: This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.
Travel Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.
HSE Awareness: All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.
Why Join Us? This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.
We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high e NPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.
Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.
Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Especialista front-end
